utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Registrar, kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, registrar. Today, it is Wednesday. I would like to greet all the people present in the courtroom, the representatives of the Prosecution, Defence counsel, as well as the accused. Mr. Pusic, as I can see, is not with us this morning, so we need to resume the witness's testimony, but I shall first give the floor to the registrar so we can have a few IC numbers, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Two parties have submitted lists of documents to be tendered through Kemal Likic. The list submitted by the OTP shall be given Exhibit IC 789, while the list submitted by 3D shall be given Exhibit IC 790. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well. We shall move back into closed session. Drop the blind, please, and bring the witness into the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 24th day of January, 2008, at 8.30 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.47 p.m.,
